savedElsewhere: The document was updated elsewhere, so this change was not saved

paused.unsupported: This document has formatting the editor can't display, so autosave is paused. Edit in source mode to save
paused.readOnly: Read-only mode doesn't autosave. Switch back to editing to save these changes

editor.saveConflict: The document changed elsewhere, so this save didn't go through. Press ⌘S to overwrite it with your version
